name: Classic Punter
summary: Classic Punter offers you the chance to make a fortune and become rich by betting on horses in a racing meeting, where you can choose the number of races between 1 and 50. One or two players can play and bet. The goal of a single player is to win £1,000,000 and in a two player game the goal is to beat the other player. At the start of the game you are presented with your first race with a selection of horses and their odds. You can choose a winning bet or a prediction bet. A win bet allows you to bet on the winner, while a prediction bet allows you to bet on the horses in first and second place.
